[RDSC.3.6] `dsc_sha256` is the SHA-256 of the DSC byte
sequence with the `dsc_sha256` field itself zeroed during
hash computation; the compiler patches the real hash in
after computing it. During the computation the field is present, as 32 zero
bytes; it is not omitted. Encoded as the raw 32 bytes per
[RBND.3.2]. At load, the runtime must recompute the hash with the
field zeroed and refuse an artefact whose `dsc_sha256` does not match, with
`DS_ERR_DSC_SEMANTIC` ([NERR.8.1]).
